description: A small campsite seen from close above, on rough, speckled orange-brown earth. Near the top centre burns a campfire built of red-brown logs laid out like the spokes of a wheel, with a bright yellow and white flame rising from the middle. In the lower half lies a large, rounded blue bundle, a bedroll or a packed cloak, shaded from deep blue to bright cyan where the firelight hits it. At the lower right rests a hand axe with a long red-brown handle and a polished steel head. The scene is dark around the edges and warm near the fire, a cosy, watchful mood of a rest in the wilderness. Frame 1: the flame stands tall with jagged yellow tongues. Frame 2: the flame shifts shape, its tips leaning and flickering to new points, and the glow on the bundle changes slightly. Both frames are held equally and briefly, so the loop reads as a quick, constant flicker of firelight.
title: Campfire beside bedroll and axe
